_comment: Which lemma LEADS a folded Arabic key (#253). Read by the `ar` profile in
Unvocalized Arabic writes several words the same way, so 6,133 of 25,747
keys carry more than one lemma. Only 341 of those are collisions our own
alef fold created; the other 5,792 are the script omitting its vowels, and
no keying choice avoids them. Every lemma's senses merge under the one key,
so nothing is lost — but the order is kaikki's etymology order, and for a
short list of very frequent words that order puts a rare verb in front of
the particle or preposition a learner actually met.
Each value is the vocalized `canonical` form of the lemma that must lead.
The build FAILS if a key here matches no record, so a typo cannot go quiet.
Curated against the top 200 of scripts/coverage-corpus-ar.txt: the other
176 colliding keys in that band already lead correctly and are left alone.
Add a word only when the wrong lead is not in dispute — the test is whether
a beginner meets the word in their first hour and would be taught an error.
